recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for current FHIR core unless a work group explicitly decides to revive or migrate the old questionnaire-deReference extension into a maintained package.
issue_request: FHIR-6829 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 technical correction asking that the SDC Implemented CDE extension XML declare extension.valueReference as Reference(DataElement).
initial_application: Jira comments say the issue was already fixed. No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-6829, but the retained historical R2 extension bundle defines questionnaire-deReference with snapshot Extension.valueReference typed as Reference and profiled to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DataElement; its differential also constrains Extension.value[x] to the same DataElement reference.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini comments out DataElement as a current resource, work group, and TLA entry. Current searches for questionnaire-deReference/Implemented CDE find only tools/history/release2 and legacy tooling references in core, and no matching definition in the Extension Pack. Jira neighborhood search found only FHIR-6829; community searches found no conflicting Confluence record and only a 2016 Zulip mention pointing to the existing extension page.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The historical artifact already carries the requested representation, and there is no active current-build source or extension-pack artifact requiring correction.
